title: FTC along translates for Lipschitz functions, valid for a.e. base point
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ L-Lipschitz (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) and z ∈ ℝⁿ. Then for Lebesgue-almost every p ∈ ℝⁿ: u(p + z) − u(p) = ∫_0^1 Du(p + τz)z dτ, where Du = fderiv ℝ u.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (z : Euclid n), LipschitzWith L u → ∀ᵐ p : Euclid n, u (p + z) - u p = ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ u (p + τ • z) z
